scope.compiler: XLA executable estimates; kernel registers and shared memory excluded
scope.content: SHA-256 of actual dynamic-array paths, dtype, shape and C-order bytes; device-independent
scope.fragment: declared per-fragment kernel operand/result bytes; no node/edge scaling
scope.initialization: shared constructor/input and topology phases are not per-route costs
scope.interpret: cpu_interpret verifies kernel semantics; not GPU performance evidence
scope.sampled: PhaseMemorySampler sampled resident peak above phase baseline; never a bound
scope.timing: synchronized host wall time per phase
scope.transfer: explicit dynamic-array device_put plus synchronization; null when not requested
scope.workspace: declared per-program planning bound of the accelerated kernels
